Name: Domed Garden Pots
Author: Wandox99
Description:
[size=4][center][b]1.6 COMPATIBLE[/b][/center][/size]
[b]NOW WORK AS INTENDED![/b]

Hello everyone!
This mod add 19 big craftable items called Domed Garden Pots  that let you put seeds inside, from 1 to 999 and getting the crops.
Search the various shops to find them and be able to buy them. More expensive is it: more seeds can hold inside.
The most expensive of all will make you harvest iridium-quality crops.
It works with every vanilla's seeds in game with the exception of the tree sappling (fruit and wild), the tea sappling and mixed [b]flower [/b]seeds.
For every crop you will need a seed, example:
1 pumpkin seed: 1 pumpkin
750 pumpkin seeds: 750 pumpkin.
Each Domed Garden pot can hold different quantity of seeds!
Crops that regrow in vanilla (like ancient fruit) [b]now regrow[/b], so you can put inside all the seeds you can, it will continue to make the fruit or vegetable as long as you don't destroy the pot!

Other seeds have differents mechanics: 
Coffee bean: for obtain 999 coffee bean in a diamond pot: you need to put inside only 250 coffee beans. Coffee crop normally give 4 coffee beans, and now it work as intended!
The mixed seeds can grow some crops that are able to regrow, so, don't waste that little seeds anymore: put them into a domed garden pot!

[size=5]Install[/size]
1. [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
4. Run the game using SMAPI.


If you want to aumate the Domed Garden Pots you need to download: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate [/url]﻿by Pathoschild.
